description: This Java class 'BankingServiceHelper' provides utility methods for converting between domain models and data transfer objects (DTOs) related to banking entities such as Customer, Account, Address, Contact, BankInfo, Transaction, and TransferDetails. It utilizes builder patterns for object creation and is likely a Spring component used for mapping data structures within a banking application.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods for converting between domain and entity representations of banking data objects, facilitating data transformation within the application.
